gaps.sentence: He joined ___ army when he was eighteen.
gaps.explanation: Institutions take 'the': the army, the police, the church.

gaps.sentence: My grandmother goes to ___ church every morning before work.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to church' (as worshipper) takes no article; 'the church' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: ___ problem is that people don't recycle enough.
gaps.explanation: The problem (the one we are discussing); people in general takes no article.

gaps.sentence: My uncle is ___ university lecturer and a painter in his free time.
gaps.explanation: 'A university lecturer' (the u sounds like /juː/); the second gap is also 'an artist'.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.
gaps.explanation: 'Have a wonderful/great/good time' — 'time' here is countable and takes 'a'.

gaps.sentence: ___ piano was invented in Italy in the early eighteenth century.
gaps.explanation: 'The + singular instrument' refers to the whole class: the piano.
